title: The most exciting moment from last night! #broadway #musicaltheatre #...
transcript: Literally, what are the odds that both times I've seen Kristen Chenoweth in a Broadway musical, they had to stop the show for a technical difficulty? Not only that, but both times it was basically the same technical difficulty, and both times she, like, improvised a line to play it off. So last night I saw Queen of Versailles, which, like the show itself? A conversation for another time. But like five minutes into the show, when they do the first set change, and the thing lifts up It didn't lift up all the way. And she was on stage in the chair being like, “uhhh” And she improvised a line, being like, “normally in film, this is where we stop the show.” But she said it in character. I was a little confused. I didn't really get it at first, but then the god mic, of course, was like, “we're pausing the show.” “Cast off stage, please.” And then when she came back on, she was like, “it's good to see me, isn't it?” Which, like, alright…🙄 but literally, the last time I saw her on Broadway was like 11 years ago in On thr 20th century, and the same thing happened, except kind of the reverse, I guess. There was a set piece that wouldn't come down. So when they restarted, they had to go back a little bit and repeat a bit of the section from the beginning of the Musical sequence. And she has this line where she sings, “what will become of my movie?” And she sang instead “I feel like I've sung this before,” which was very funny. but now I'm wondering, like, what is it? Is it me? Is it her? Is it she and I just can't be in the same Broadway theatre without making the set malfunction? If so, I would like to formally apologize to everyone in the Queen of Versailles audience last night for making the show run longer.
